alternative_explanations: Any gain may be ordinary finite-map completion or evaluator-specific consistency closure already explained more cheaply by exact MDL, spectral weighted automata or constrained matrix completion.
confounds: Invalidate on fixture failure, state-ID or world-order non-equivariance, train/test composition overlap, privileged labels or generator access, target or seed leakage, post-score tuning, semantic-baseline mismatch, state-budget breach or evaluator digest change.
falsification_criteria: Discard this exact learner if the preregistered partial-permutation fixture is not solved exactly under state relabeling and world-order permutation, scored accuracy is below 0.95, minimum-combination accuracy is below 0.90, either causal ablation is within 0.10, or a simpler implementable control Pareto-dominates it.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any overlap between registered training and held-out compositions.
Invalidate if module IDs, source families, native types, extraction paths or the composition graph reach an implementable candidate.
Invalidate if public support, query or target shapes identify a composition above chance plus 0.10.
Invalidate if scoring-state conjugation or support partitions are realized before integrity and source audit.
Invalidate on target access, scoring-seed leakage, post-score tuning, state-budget breach or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: A crash rejects only the implementation; fixture, leakage, seed, semantic-control or integrity failure invalidates the experiment and permits no scientific interpretation.
outcome_policy.null: A valid null makes this exact equation-propagation learner dormant without tuning the frozen split, support, role contract, controls or thresholds after observing scores.
outcome_policy.positive: A valid one-seed result meeting the fixture, quality, ablation and Pareto gates supports only preregistering unchanged adversarial replication; it is not promotion or evidence of general intelligence.

predicted_outcome: The shared relation learner is unlikely but testably capable of exact partial-permutation completion and at least 0.95 held-out accuracy, 0.90 minimum-combination accuracy and 0.10 advantage over both source-identical ablations; exact MDL is the strongest implementable null.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; one valid positive seed may authorize only an unchanged three-seed adversarial replication with a new held-out composition and all semantic, integrity and full-cost gates intact.
research_question: Can one permutation-equivariant operator-equation learner complete the unseen ordered CB map more accurately per fully charged cost than direct pair selection, independent fitting, no-relation propagation and frozen classical controls?
title: Anonymous operator-algebra completion on held-out recombination
